custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with 4 on hand.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order A, with one line for another part, line 1, not yet received.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in tab 1 on purchase order A.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425741 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425741-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type any existing part number in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then Save & Close. A purchase order made this way has no work order, so its page shows the Add Order Item button.
